sentences.text: Gaucher disease type I and Gaucher disease type II are both recorded as caused by the gene GBA1 [e_d56da1ee4888] [e_8a9c88239791].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from OMIM and Orphanet [e_d56da1ee4888] [e_8a9c88239791].
Constellate computed that the two types share this causal gene, at confidence 0.95 [e_34272bdebcd2].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_34272bdebcd2].
For type I, two features are recorded, raised glucosylsphingosine seen in 64 of 64 cases and an overactive spleen listed as very frequent [e_36833e6b1d46] [e_763e9def1b0e].
For type II, there is one completed study on ClinicalTrials.gov of delivering an enzyme to the brain, and one older research record in NIH RePORTER [e_46cb9b7dc0bb] [e_1daf626cd3bf].
These edges do not show the results of that study, and they list no symptoms for type II [e_46cb9b7dc0bb] [e_8a9c88239791].
